```lean
intro n
have h : Nat.gcd (2 * n + 1) (n + 1) = 1 :=
  by
    let d := Nat.gcd (2 * n + 1) (n + 1)
    have hd : d ∣ 2 * n + 1 := by simp [Nat.dvd_gcd]
    have hd2 : d ∣ n + 1 := by simp [Nat.dvd_gcd]
    have hd3 : d ∣ (2 * n + 1) - 2 * (n + 1) := by simp [Nat.dvd_sub, hd, hd2]
    simp [hd3] at hd3
    have hd4 : d ∣ -1 := by simp [hd3, Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff]
    have hd5 : d ∣ 1 := by rw [Nat.dvd_neg_iff, hd4]
    exact Nat.dvd_antisymm (Nat.dvd_refl d) hd5
```
